findings.evidence: `Cyclic.lean:43` declares `[CommGroup G] [IsCyclic G] [Finite G]`, while `Cyclic.lean:48`, `:54`, and `:60` consequently expose the restriction; Mathlib’s finite-only helper is confirmed at `Mathlib/GroupTheory/SpecificGroups/Cyclic.lean:634`, but that proof API limitation does not limit the mathematical statement.
findings.fix: Remove `[Finite G]` from the public signatures and prove the cardinality theorem by separating finite cyclic groups from the infinite cyclic case; derive the even-card and two-rank corollaries from that generalized theorem.
findings.issue: The file-level `[Finite G]` unnecessarily restricts all three cyclic results. For an infinite cyclic commutative group, `Nat.card G = 0`, so the same formula gives `gcd 0 2 = 2`, and the even-card and two-rank conclusions remain valid.

summary: The cyclic square-class API is unnecessarily restricted to finite groups; its stated cardinality formula naturally also covers infinite cyclic groups.
